outputs.summary: createGitRepo (src/test/gitRepo.ts) now retries temp-folder creation plus `git init` as one unit. It makes up to 3 attempts with a 50 ms then 100 ms backoff, and each attempt uses a fresh temp folder; a failed attempt's folder is removed with removeScratch. The retry fires only on the busy/locked-folder class that the ticket names: errno EBUSY/EPERM/EACCES from the temp-folder calls (syscall mkdtemp/mkdir/realpath), or git stderr matching `could not lock`, `Device or resource busy` or `Permission denied` from `git init`. Every other failure throws its original error on the first attempt: a different git error, the same errno from spawnSync git (git cannot start or is missing), ENOSPC, or EBUSY on a non-temp syscall. Any failure after `git init` also throws at once, including in the initial commit and later repo.git()/commit() calls. Each retry writes a console.warn line containing git's stderr, so a retry cannot hide a flake. execFileSync, createTempRepo, warn and pause can be injected through an optional `createGitRepo(overrides)`; the existing zero-argument callers are unchanged. Red team (reviewer subagent, 11 findings; repros in /tmp/sc-epic/scratch/DM-147-redteam/). Attacked and held: '..', 'sub/../../x', absolute POSIX and Windows paths, UNC paths, NUL, the empty string, option-like '-x'; './a', 'a//b', a trailing slash, different letter case and NFD/NFC are refused because the path must exactly equal git's unmerged path; a symlinked parent folder or file pointing outside the repo; links into .git/.GIT/.git/modules; symlink loops; FIFO (the isFile check comes before open); stale Commit merge (main re-reads status); abortOperation refuses merge/none; MERGE_MSG located via rev-parse --git-path and capped. Fixed, each with a regression test: P1 openInEditor handed executables, .app/.command and other launchable names, folders and FIFOs to shell.openPath; it now requires a plain file with no execute bit and no OS-launched extension, and refuses any '.git' segment (nested repos). P2 pathspec magic: a conflicted file named ':/foo' or ':!x' touched other files; checkout/add/rm now run with --literal-pathspecs. P2 submodule Use theirs staged our commit; it now uses update-index --cacheinfo with the chosen stage. P2 rebase sides inverted; the UI now swaps them during a rebase. P2 conflict-marker-size markers were missed; any run of 7 or more '<' followed by a space now counts. P2 a normal commit during a stash-restore conflict wiped the unmerged entries; commitFiles refuses with merge_conflicts and the commit box is hidden while conflicts last. P2 a previous operation's conflicts showed up as phantom 'Resolved' rows; the resource key now carries an activation counter. P3 the marker scan blocked main; it is now async. P3 one unreadable file failed every call; it now counts as 1 (still conflicted). Consciously not fixed: the stat-then-open and locate-then-openPath races, which need someone who can already write to the working tree; every action still rescans all conflicted files (async now). On Windows I expect fs.stat to report no execute bits (libuv), so only the extension list applies there [INFERENCE, not run on Windows]. The .js/.sh/.ps1 refusal means such conflicted files must be opened from an editor; the message says so.

- title: Read rebase markers before MERGE_HEAD when detecting the operation in progress
